diagnostics.openHint: A complete, on-device record of what the app did: screens, taps, requests, sync speed, errors.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.intro: A detailed record of what this app does, kept only on this device. Addresses, transaction IDs and keys are replaced by short pseudonyms, amounts by a rough size, and seeds, phrases, PINs and memos are never recorded. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you export it.
diagnostics.hintNormal: Records screens, taps, requests, sync progress, errors and slow moments. Recommended.
diagnostics.hintVerbose: Also records every status poll, every request and debug engine lines. Use while chasing a problem, then switch back.
diagnostics.exportShared: Logs handed to the share sheet.
diagnostics.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
